archetypes.name: dyn-plan-artifacts
archetypes.rationale: Plan-review artifact persistence changed across multiple terminal paths.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the changed plan-review tally and zero-findings short-circuit code for artifact lifecycle regressions. Focus on whether cumulative accepted files preserve prior rounds without duplicating exact blocks, while round-local artifacts still reflect only the current round. Check the tests exercise both the normal tally path and the zero-findings shortcut. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
